ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.inter_code != :vi_block.inter_code or
 :global.inter_type != :vi_block.inter_type then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :global.inter_code||','||
 :global.inter_type||
 ',','D',chk);
 
 end if;
IF :global.inter_code = :vi_block.inter_code and
 :global.inter_type = :vi_block.inter_type 
THEN
 null;
ELSE 
 if :vi_block.inter_code is not null and
 :vi_block.inter_type is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_interdictions
 WHERE inter_code = :vi_block.inter_code and
 inter_type = :vi_block.inter_type ;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :vi_block.inter_code||','||
 :vi_block.inter_type||
 ',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :vi_block.inter_code||','||
 :vi_block.inter_type||
 ',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN

 item_change('ctrl_block.inter_type',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.INTER_CODE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.inter_code',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.SEARCH_STR' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.search_str',action);
 end if;

 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_proc_grp',action);
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
chk boolean;
q_str varchar2(1500) := '1 = 1 ';
begin
 if :ctrl_block.inter_type is not null then
 q_str := q_str||'and inter_type = :ctrl_block.inter_type ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.inter_code is not null then
 q_str := q_str||'and inter_code like '''||'%'||:ctrl_block.inter_code||'%'||''' ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.search_str is not null then
 q_str := q_str||'and upper(inter_desc) like '''||'%'||upper(:ctrl_block.search_str)||'%'||''' ';
 end if;

set_block_property('vi_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,q_str);
go_block('vi_block');
execute_query;


end;
